rows: Pea to penny size hail fell in a swath from southwestern Borden County on Farm to Market Road 1054 to Gail.
Two to three inch diameter tree branches were broken off by severe thunderstorm winds.

The West Texas Mesonet station two miles east-southeast of Gail measured an 86 mph wind gust before communications were lost. After the storm, a West Texas Mesonet representative went to the station and reported that the radio antenna had been bent and one of the guy wires was da…
Hen egg sized hail fell northeast of Gail accompanied by strong winds and a funnel cloud.
Baseball sized hail fell north of Gail.
The West Texas Mesonet station three miles west northwest of Fluvanna (KFVS) recorded a wind gust of 61 mph. No damage was reported.
Penny sized hail was reported along Farm to Market road 1054 North.
Penny to nickel sized hail covered the ground twelve miles northeast of Gail.
Quarter to golfball sized hail covered the ground in Gail.
A trained spotter reported quarter size hail covering the ground 13 miles northeast of Gail.
The duration of the hail was estimated for this event.

A severe thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced golfball, tennis ball, and softball sized hail fifteen miles northeast of Gail. This hail broke windshields on vehicles. The cost of the damage done to the windshields is an rough estimate.
A severe thunderstorm moved over Borden County and produced a 77 mph wind gust measured by the mesonet three miles west northwest of Fluvanna.
A thunderstorm moved over Borden County and produced 60 to 70 mph wind gusts in Gail. No damage was reported with this storm.
A thunderstorm moved over Borden County and produced quarter sized hail in Gail.
A thunderstorm moved over Borden County and produced a 62 mph wind gust three miles west northwest of Fluvanna.
A thunderstorm moved over Borden County and produced a 70 mph wind gust three miles west northwest of Fluvanna.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 59 mph wind gust at both 5:30 pm and 5:35 pm CDT at the mesonet station near Gail. No damage was reported.

A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a brief tornado about 16 miles northwest of Gail. The time the tornado was on the ground, the path width and length were estimated. There was no damage reported, so the tornado was rated as an EF-0.
Report of golf ball sized hail in Gail came from the Borden County Sheriff's Office.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 60 mph wind gust sixteen miles northwest of Gail.

A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced wind damage north of Lake JB Thomas. Ten power poles were blown down north of Lake JB Thomas and west of Bull Creek Channel but the exact location is not known. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 66 mph wind gust at the mesonet site near Gail.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 69 mph wind gust near Gail.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced wind damage ten miles south of Gail. Power poles were blown down along Willow Valley Road. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 58 mph wind gust two miles east southeast of Gail.
A thunderstorm produced a brief rope tornado seven miles southwest of Gail. The path width and length were estimated and no damage was reported.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 60 mph wind gust three miles west northwest of Fluvanna.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 59 mph wind gust in Gail.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 60 mph wind gust six miles northwest of Fluvanna.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced an estimated 60 mph wind gust in Gail.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced an 83 mph wind gust at the mesonet site near Gail.

A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced wind gusts estimated to be 80 to 85 mph in Gail. Damages include roofs blown off, fences destroyed, trees blown over, sheds blown over, bent poles, and a damaged stop sign. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.

A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 63 mph wind gust at the mesonet site near Gail.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 58 mph wind gust at the mesonet site near Fluvanna.
A thunderstorm produced hail seven miles northwest of Fluvanna. There was a report of broken home windows. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm produced a 59 mph wind gust three miles west northwest of Fluvanna.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 58 mph wind gust at the mesonet site near Gail.
A thunderstorm produced a 57 mph wind gust near Gail.
A thunderstorm moved across Borden County and produced a 59 mph wind gust at the Mesonet site near Gail.
A thunderstorm produced a 70 mph wind gust at the Mesonet site near Fluvanna.
Quarter to golf ball size hail east of Gail on US Highway 180.
The West Texas Mesonet Station 26 Gail 2SE recorded a 59 mph wind gust.
The 31 Fluvanna 3W West Texas Mesonet station recorded a 59 mph wind gust, as well as a 58 mph wind gust a few minutes before.
The West Texas Mesonet station 26 Gail 2SE measured a 67 mph wind gust.
The West Texas Mesonet station 31 Fluvanna 3W recorded a 60 mph wind gust.
